source.round_icon_note: Both adaptive entries share the diffuse foreground and the independently occlusion-clipped tonal monochrome.
source.origin: Samsung OHO+ 9.3.13.0 source geometry retained for phone, screen, hand and cuff. Material and gesture indicator adapted for CHO; not an official Samsung or OPPO app.

design.concept: Neutral white and gray phone/screen/continuous hand. Original OHO phone and hand silhouette, no separate cuff or palm structure. Thin restrained glass edges reference OPPO Video, Music and Theme Store launcher art.
design.material: One composite alpha .94, diffuse neutral white/gray fills, thin inward contour highlights. No newly drawn hand structure, no sleeve split or local palm shading.
design.sampling_note: Colors sampled from the installed Settings bitmap; not original shader stop values.
design.monochrome: Three disjoint regions: phone .64, filled screen .34, whole visible hand and arm 1. Rear/front hand union is one shape; no cuff or palm split.

notification.note: Compact opaque phone-and-hand symbol retained for status-bar legibility; separate from tonal launcher monochrome.
